title: Repair known creature saves, outcomes, lifecycle, variants, and selected economies
description:
Repair known creature findings involving save branches/alternatives, rider and ongoing
damage, triggers/durations/recovery, variants, transformations/summoning,
legendary-economy data, and identified projection losses. Use independently source-derived
structural populations for exhaustive assertions; deterministic execution is required only
for positive selected operations and state-integrity owners.
design:
2026-10-09 DESIGN (Claude Captain, main 6413bcc7). Lane A, profile rules-clause-complete. Creature mechanics are source projections; no deterministic capability consumes creature legendary budgets, saves arrays, or riders (implementer re-verifies by grep before relying on it). Already repaired, verify not regressed: half-damage branches (PR #567), per-option legendary costs (usage.legendaryActionCost, 39/39 typed). Coordinate with PR #646 (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.2, creature attack alternatives): build on whichever of main / #646 is merged at dispatch time; if #646 is still open, base on main and expect a regenerate-on-merge.
L1 LEGENDARY BUDGET (opus:F-26): legendaryActions.description prints 'can take N legendary actions' (snapshot: 30 creatures, all N=3) but no typed budget exists. Add to the legendaryActions object: budget: N (from that sentence only), and, only where the description prints them, timing: 'end-of-another-creatures-turn' ('only at the end of another creature's turn') and regain: 'start-of-own-turn' ('regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn'), oneAtATime: true ('Only one legendary action option can be used at a time'). A description lacking the budget sentence gets no budget (fail closed; report any).
M1 MULTI-SAVE (opus:F-32): entries printing two or more 'DC N <Ability> saving throw' clauses carry only the first in mechanics.saves (snapshot 3: air-elemental Whirlwind, ice-devil Wall of Ice, purple-worm Bite). Emit every printed save in source order, each with its own DC/ability and its own success branch where printed (reuse parseSaveWithSuccessBranch per clause; do not flatten branches across clauses). Population by query: printed save clauses per entry > typed saves.
R1 RIDERS (fable:F3): creature entries whose text prints an extra-damage rider or ongoing hit-point loss with no projection (snapshot 22 entries: Charge x12 incl. boar/centaur/elk/giant-boar/giant-elk/giant-goat/giant-sea-horse/goat/minotaur/minotaur-skeleton/rhinoceros/unicorn/wereboar; Sneak Attack (assassin, spy); Heated Weapons (azer, salamander); Hellish Weapons (erinyes); Martial Advantage (hobgoblin); Divine Eminence (priest); infernal wound (bearded-devil Glaive, horned-devil Tail)). Representation: reuse the existing extraDamage effect {kind:'extraDamage', dice, average?, type? (ONLY when printed; Martial Advantage/Sneak Attack print no type - leave it absent, never infer the weapon type), trigger: <verbatim condition clause>} and add frequency: 'once-per-turn' only where printed ('Once per turn', '(1/Turn)'). Infernal wound: a new effect kind recurringHitPointLoss {dice, average?, trigger: 'start of each of its turns' (verbatim), endsWhen: <verbatim end clause>} because the source says 'lose N hit points' (not damage; resistances do not apply - do NOT model it as recurringDamage). Charge riders whose second sentence imposes a save/prone keep that in saves/conditions as today; only add the missing extra damage. Validate new fields in kindSchemas (fail closed).
indep:006 (creature-completeness, 'Creature stat-block mechanics/entries complete'): narrowed under ADR 0020; surviving obligation = emitted creature projections agree with the printed stat block (statline gate, attack grammar gate, this rider/save/budget repair).
REGISTRY: legendary-economy (F-26), multi-save-entries (F-32), creature-ongoing-riders (fable:F3) stay accepted with reasoning naming this repair; creature-completeness (indep:006) -> narrowed; half-damage-branches (F-25) already carries its disposition.
EVIDENCE: one new test file: (a) every legendaryActions object with a printed budget sentence has budget equal to the printed N (independent regex in the test), and none without; (b) for every creature entry, typed saves count equals printed 'DC N <Ability> saving throw' clause count and each DC/ability matches in order; (c) every entry printing 'extra N (XdY)( <type>)? damage' or 'lose N (XdY) hit points' has a matching extraDamage / recurringHitPointLoss effect with the same dice and the printed type or no type; exact source regressions for purple-worm Bite, hobgoblin Martial Advantage, horned-devil Tail, one Charge creature, aboleth budget.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known creature source/projection findings are repaired with generalized evidence over justified bounded source families.
- Multiple saves and alternatives are represented without flattening.
- Legendary budgets/costs are accurate wherever projected or consumed by selected capabilities.
- Rider/ongoing effects retain source semantics for discovery/adjudication even when not deterministically executed.
- No semantic-review matrix is proof that every creature mechanic is captured or implemented.

Behavior is unchanged for every SRD creature (all 30 print the budget); add a test that a block without a typed budget refuses. Profile for this part: semantic-system (in-force capability state). Update the capability inventory? No - PR #643 is separate; note the change in the report so the inventory statement can be checked.
